selection.source_context: Universal Pictures At Home Extended Preview gallery thumbnail for Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas.

crop.semantics: Simulation of the current wall image box. East focus preserves both eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, chin, fur, and the complete expression; centered and west crops were rejected.

notes: The selected official Universal frame visibly depicts Jim Carrey's adult live-action 2000 Grinch.
The frame preserves green facial appliances and fur, yellow eyes, prosthetic nose and muzzle, broken expression lines, teeth, and the distinctive hair silhouette.
The official source page identifies the film, Jim Carrey, the 2000 release year, and Universal Studios.
The default centered crop was rejected because it clipped the right side of the face; the east-focused crop retains both eyes and the full expression.
The candidate is not Jim Carrey unmasked, child Grinch, animation, another Who, merchandise, a poster, sequel-only imagery, or an unrelated namesake.
Exact-byte duplicate screening must pass against 2,070 canonical repository hashes.
